marks.gloss_en: דאמר רב חסדא: מ"ם וסמ"ך שבלוחות בנס היו עומדין -- the closed forms go back to the tablets
דאמר רבי ירמיה ואיתימא רבי חייא בר אבא: מנצפ"ך צופים אמרום
one who makes an open letter closed elevates it
ותיסברא? והכתיב אלה המצות -- a prophet may not innovate anything from now on
אלא מיהוה הואי ... ואתו צופים תקנינהו -- the forms existed; the seers established which is medial and which final
ואכתי אלה המצות -- even fixing their positions is innovating
אלא שכחום וחזרו ויסדום -- they had been forgotten and were re-established
'these are the commandments' -- a prophet may not innovate anything from now on
Rav Chisda: the writing in the tablets was read from inside and read from outside, e.g. nevuv/bovan, rahav/bahar, saru/vras
מסייע ליה לריש לקיש -- the pupils' kuf (its own gap for the one who repents) supports Reish Lakish's dictum
וליעול בהך! -- [why the gap in the leg?] let him enter by that [other opening]
מסייע ליה לריש לקיש -- it supports Reish Lakish: one who comes to defile, they open for him; one who comes to purify, they help him

Reish Lakish: what is meant by 'if it concerns the scorners, He scorns them, and to the humble He gives grace' (Prov 3:34)? one who comes to defile himself -- they open for him; one who comes to purify himself -- they help him
the Rabbis: pupils came today to the study hall and said things the like of which were not said even in the days of Joshua bin Nun
heh-vav: this is the name of the Holy One, blessed be He
samekh-ayin: support the poor (smoch aniyim)
kuf: holy (kadosh); resh: wicked (rasha)
shin: falsehood (sheker); tav: truth (emet)

alef-tav beit-shin: he loathed Me -- shall I desire him? he did not desire Me -- shall My name rest on him? gimmel-resh: he defiled his body -- shall I pity him? dalet-kuf: he locked My doors -- shall I not cut off his horns? thus far the attribute of the wicked

but the attribute of the righteous: alef-tav beit-shin -- if you are abashed; gimmel-resh dalet-kuf -- if you do so, dwell on high (bedok); heh-tzadi vav-peh -- a partition is between you and anger; zayin-ayin chet-samekh tet-nun -- and you will not tremble before the Satan

the Holy One said: alef-chet-samekh beit-tet-ayin gimmel-yod-peh -- I pity them, for they spurned adultery; dalet-kaf-tzadi -- they are pure, they are honest, they are righteous; heh-lamed-kuf -- you have no portion in them
He said to him: alef-lamed beit-mem [not with them]; gimmel-nun dalet-samekh -- where shall I lead them? to the garden of myrtle
